tagline: 目的はありません。好きなところを掘って、好きなところに置くだけ。
title: 掘って、置くだけ。

controls.keyboard: WASD move, Space jump, F hold dig, G place, 1–8 material; Escape pause
controls.pointer: Explicit Pointer Lock mouse look / left hold dig / right place; alternative drag look plus F/G or dedicated buttons; wheel material
controls.touch: Independent left movement stick, right drag look, DIG hold, PLACE tap, JUMP; fixed per-pointer roles

expectedRunSecondsBasis: No imposed goal, time limit or run duration; human duration not measured

currentManifest.failure: none; invalid actions have no penalty
currentManifest.save: IndexedDB final-state chunk differences; local only
currentManifest.prototypeStatus: technical QA required; human enjoyment unverified
currentManifest.rights: original terrain, code surfaces, UI and synthesized sound; Three.js MIT

controls.pc: WASD Space; pointer lock left DIG/right PLACE or draglook F/G

humanEvaluation: Pending; technical prototype publication authorized, author and physical-device subjective play unperformed
telemetryCoverage: Existing lifecycle plus coarse non-overlapping session_summary intervals; no world seed/id/voxel layout/backup/position history; external collection disabled pending existing Worker production registration
analyticsAggregation: Only interval mined/placed/active seconds/return deltas summed; depth/material maxima; run_end totals not repeated. Missing summaries remain missing; daily archive is generic only.
